verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Flag delimitation — 0x7E opens and closes every frame; shared-flag back-to-back transmission.
Synchronous bit stuffing — insert 0 after 5 ones; strip 0 after 5 ones; detect 7+ ones as abort.
Asynchronous octet stuffing — 0x7E → 0x7D 0x5E; 0x7D → 0x7D 0x5D; 0x7D 0x7E → abort.
Idle line — continuous 1s and continuous 0x7E both accepted by receiver.
I-frame normal control field — N(R)[3] P/F N(S)[3] 0 bit layout.
I-frame extended control field — N(R)[7] P/F N(S)[7] 0 bit layout.
S-frame RR / REJ / RNR / SREJ encoding and behavior.
U-frame mode-set acceptance (UA) and rejection (DM / FRMR).
U-frame DISC → UA → DM sequence.
U-frame XID capability exchange.
U-frame TEST loopback.
U-frame UI / UIH unacknowledged datagram.
Sliding window — 7 (mod-8) and 127 (mod-128) outstanding frames.
N(S) wrap modulo 8 and modulo 128.
N(R) acknowledgement of all I-frames with N(S) < N(R).
P/F bit single-token enforcement.
Checkpoint retransmission rule.
FCS computation — 16-bit CRC-CCITT polynomial 0x1021 with init 0xFFFF + output inversion.
FCS computation — 32-bit CRC-32 polynomial 0x04C11DB7 with init 0xFFFFFFFF + output inversion.
FCS residue check — 0x1D0F for CRC-CCITT, 0xC704DD7B (or 0) for CRC-32.
FCS error — silent discard + REJ/SREJ-driven retransmission OR T1 timeout retransmission.
Abort detection — discard partial frame + return to FLAG_HUNT.
FRMR with W (unknown frame), X (unexpected info), Y (info too large), Z (invalid N(R)), V (invalid N(S)).
RSET (ABM only) — reset N(R) to 0.
Mode escalation — NRM → DISC → DM → SABM → ABM full transition.
Address extension — multi-byte address with top-bit-0 continuation.
Multidrop addressing (SDLC NRM) — primary polls each secondary by address.
Group polling — UP command in NRM.
Disconnect handshake — DISC → UA → DM.
Re-initialization — SIM / RIM (vendor-specific secondary init).
fields.notes: ISO/IEC 13239 does not include a formal verification plan; the above categories are derived from the elements-of-procedure clauses. Industry conformance suites (LAPB ITU-T X.25 conformance, ISDN LAPD conformance, V.42 LAPM conformance) implement these scenarios programmatically.
